description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' that renders the top navigation bar of the application. It includes links to the homepage, browsing, history, login, register, and user account management, integrating context hooks for authentication ('useAuth') and theme ('useTheme'), as well as routing with 'react-router-dom'.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Functional React component rendering the header/navigation bar with dynamic content based on authentication and theme state.
